# RT-Thread Nano 3.1.5

- Upstream: RT-Thread Nano 3.1.5
- Distribution: official Keil/CMSIS pack
  `RealThread.RT-Thread.3.1.5.pack`
- Download: `https://www.rt-thread.org/download/mdk/RealThread.RT-Thread.3.1.5.pack`
- Version in source: `RT_VERSION 3`, `RT_SUBVERSION 1`, `RT_REVISION 5`
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE` and `AUTHORS`)

## Included

- `include/`: rtthread.h, rtdef.h, rthw.h, rtservice.h, rtdbg.h, rtdebug.h
- `src/`: clock, components, cpu, idle, ipc, irq, kservice, mem, memheap,
  mempool, object, scheduler, slab, thread, timer
- `libcpu/arm/cortex-m4/`: context_gcc.S, context_rvds.S, cpuport.c
  (`context_rvds.S` is used by the Keil AC5 project; `context_gcc.S` by CMake)
- `libcpu/arm/common/`: div0.c

## Deliberately excluded

- `components/device`, `components/finsh` (v2 uses its own device abstraction
  and has no shell)
- Other CPU ports and `divsi3.S` (ARM-state code; Cortex-M4 uses Thumb-2 and
  libgcc)
- The pack's `bsp/` examples

## Local patches

`libcpu/arm/cortex-m4/context_gcc.S`: the 3.1.5 pack uses pre-UAL conditional
instructions (`VSTMDBEQ`, `MOVEQ`, `VLDMIANE`, `BICNE`). GCC 14's Thumb-2
assembler requires them inside IT blocks. Four single-instruction IT blocks were
added; semantics are unchanged.

## Configuration

`rtconfig.h` is generated by this project's Kconfig, not copied from the pack.
The current configuration uses `RT_USING_USER_MAIN`, `RT_USING_CONSOLE`,
`RT_USING_EVENT` and `RT_USING_SEMAPHORE`, with `RT_USING_HEAP` off. It does not
enable `RT_USING_COMPONENTS_INIT`, so no `.rti_fn` initialization sections or
`rt_components_board_init()` call are required.
